facts.label: Manual saves
facts.value: Keep 15 — save before the final mission

missable_warning: Only one trophy can be missed: Positive Mental Attitude. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation. Everything else can be finished after the story.

steps.details: Play through Chapters 1–5 and finish the story. All 12 story trophies unlock on the way. Two things matter now: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia for Positive Mental Attitude (the only missable trophy), and keep a manual save before the final mission — there is no mission replay. Grab collectibles and stranger quests as you pass them.
steps.title: Play the story

steps.details: After the story, work the open world: stranger strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the counted eight), activities (stunts, shooting ranges, drone races, fishing, hunting, arcade games), collectibles (card sets, WAiNK scans, vehicles) and the big money goals (bank vaults, garages, laundering, spending). Check Progress > Activities, Progress > Gangs and Progress > Challenges to see what is left.
steps.title: Cleanup: side quests, activities, collectibles

steps.details: Finish the 100% checklist for A Long Road: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 15 Target Decks and 15 of 18 meditations. Then mop up the last stragglers — the 500 criminal-profile actions, the 8 stranger strands — and the platinum is yours.
steps.title: The final push to 100%
